name: hotkernel
description: hotkernel: Nsight/SASS tools and the kernel-speedrun loop for coding agents, measured on the GPU in your machine.

plugins.name: hotkernel
plugins.description: Ten MCP tools (gpu_info, roofline, bench, torch_trace, profile, top_kernels, disasm, verify, record, new_target) and the kernel-speedrun skill. Needs an NVIDIA GPU and a Python with PyTorch; Nsight is optional.
